title: AI Chat Bot
description: AI chat bot for Minecraft – talk to it with @bot, powered by Google AI (EN/DE).
body:
🤖 AI Chat Bot – Minecraft Plugin

AI Chat Bot adds an AI-powered chat bot to your Minecraft server that players can interact with directly in-game.
The bot responds intelligently and makes your server feel more dynamic and alive.

This plugin uses a Google AI (Gemini) API Key to generate AI responses.

👉 Get your Google AI API Key here:
[API Key](https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey)

⚠️ Note: This is my first Minecraft plugin. Feedback and suggestions are very welcome!

🌍 Language Support

🇩🇪 German

🇬🇧 English

💬 How to talk to the bot

By default, players must tag the bot at the beginning of their message using @bot.

Example:

@bot Hello, how are you?


Only messages that start with @bot will be processed by the AI.

This behavior is fully configurable and can be changed or disabled in the config file.

📌 Commands
Player Command

/aichat
Main command for normal players.

Admin Commands

/aichat reload
Reloads the configuration.

/aichat toggle
Enables or disables the AI chat system.

/aichat setkey <key>
Sets the Google AI API key.

⚙️ Features

AI-powered Minecraft chat bot

Chat via @bot at the start of the message (configurable)

Uses Google AI (Gemini)

German & English support

Easy setup and configuration

Lightweight and beginner-friendly

📞 Support / Contact

If you have questions, need help, or want to give feedback, you can tag me on Discord:
@craftvortex

❤️ Final Note

This plugin is my first Minecraft plugin, created as a learning project.
Thanks for checking it out, and enjoy chatting with your AI bot!
